claims.text: Clear cause (medications, trauma, bed rest): treat symptomatically without further study.
claims.quote: Constipation with a clear etiology (medications, trauma, bed rest) may be treated symptomatically without further study.

claims.text: Obstruction symptoms: flat and upright abdominal x-rays or abdominal CT.
claims.quote: Patients with symptoms of bowel obstruction require flat and upright abdominal radiographs (with or without contrast medium) or an abdominal CT scan

claims.text: No clear cause: colonoscopy plus CBC, TSH, fasting glucose, electrolytes and calcium.
claims.quote: Most patients without a clear etiology should have colonoscopy and a laboratory evaluation (complete blood count, thyroid-stimulating hormone, fasting glucose, electrolytes, and calcium).

claims.text: Refractory: anorectal manometry with balloon expulsion, then colonic transit studies.
claims.quote: If this trial fails, anorectal manometry with balloon expulsion should be performed to identify pelvic floor disorders and dyssynergic defecation
